avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may decrease zonisamide levels and reduce seizure control
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consult prescriber before initiating

avoid_supplements.name: Topiramate
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Dual carbonic anhydrase inhibitors increase risk of metabolic acidosis and kidney stones
avoid_supplements.action: Do not combine without explicit medical supervision

caution_supplements.name: Folate/Folic acid
caution_supplements.mechanism: Anticonvulsants may deplete folate; supplementation may be beneficial
caution_supplements.action: Monitor levels; consider supplementation if deficiency develops

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D
caution_supplements.mechanism: Anticonvulsants increase vitamin D catabolism; supplementation may help prevent bone loss
caution_supplements.action: Counsel on adequate intake; monitor bone health

caution_supplements.name: Calcium
caution_supplements.mechanism: Zonisamide may increase risk of metabolic bone disease
caution_supplements.action: Ensure adequate dietary calcium intake; consider supplementation

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Zonisamide increases kidney stone risk; sodium restriction may help reduce urinary calcium
caution_foods.action: Recommend moderate sodium intake; maintain adequate hydration

caution_foods.name: High-calcium foods in excess
caution_foods.mechanism: Excessive dietary calcium combined with metabolic acidosis may increase kidney stone risk
caution_foods.action: Maintain balanced intake; avoid excessive supplementation

monitoring_notes: Monitor renal function, serum bicarbonate, and kidney stone risk due to zonisamide's carbonic anhydrase inhibition. Counsel on hydration to minimize nephrolithiasis risk and monitor for metabolic acidosis, particularly with concurrent use of other carbonic anhydrase inhibitors.
